title: Trump says the US needs a "Federal Standard" governing oversight of AI instead of "a patchwork of 50 State Regulatory Regimes", otherwise China will catch up (Kate Sullivan/Bloomberg)
summary: Kate Sullivan /Bloomberg:Trump says the US needs a “Federal Standard” governing oversight of AI instead of “a patchwork of 50 State Regulatory Regimes”, otherwise China will catch up—  President Donald Trump called on Congress to pass a federal standard governing oversight of artificial intelligence …
